name: I Am Not A Slut!
source:
Follow the life a Reona a first year college student, she's a shy and serious girl but after some rather unfortunate events her life will be turned upside down.
Depending on your choices she will stay true to herself or become a sex addicted slutty college girl.

[From Itch.io]
translation:
跟随大学一年级学生Reona的生活，她是一个害羞而严肃的女孩，但在发生一些相当不幸的事件后，她的生活将发生翻天覆地的变化。
根据你的选择，她会忠于自己，还是成为一个沉迷于性的放荡女大学生。

[来自Itch.io]
